permission_basis: Original CC-style Blender models/materials (art/cc_family.py), retained Service Rack monitor and foundation, contacts/statuses and independent glyphs are project MIT. Approved historical Greg Flavored originals/notices retained unchanged; no external pixels or models sampled.

selection.monitor: Service Rack B monitor retained unchanged
selection.renderer: Blender 4.0.2 Cycles; committed 128 px/tile renders in art/renders
selection.technology_icons: 256px north views of the computer and Recipe Searcher

transform.contacts: socket-layout.json exported from production defs.contact/offset in Factorio 2.1.23; CC devices: modelled antenna rings checked against art/model-points.json; monitor: bezel studs at ground coordinates
transform.encoder: RGBA8 Pillow compress_level=9 for selected bodies/icons/mesh shadows; filter 0 zlib 9 for unchanged glyph/status/monitor shadow
transform.monitor: unchanged 64x64 tile/touch area and 60x60 interior; two-unit inner bezel plus four-unit exterior mechanical skirt; 72x72 chamfered artwork; unchanged ground pivot
transform.projection: CC devices: orthographic 45-degree camera, depth stretched by sqrt(2), screen 64*x, 64*(y - height/sqrt(2)); monitor: 64*x - 48*height, 64*z - 128*height; tile units; fixed world light
transform.sampling: CC devices: Blender Cycles renders at 128 px/tile, Pillow Lanczos 2x downsample; monitor: 3x depth-buffered barycentric rasterization with fixed math.fma reductions; nearest-neighbour icon fitting; exact retained monitor foundation
transform.shadow: CC devices: Cycles shadow catcher, sun from the north-west, alpha below 12 removed, alpha x0.72, Lanczos; monitor retained alpha 85
transform.status: grey dash stopped; amber slash unpowered; green powered; red fault cross; amber/steel four-frame activity
